question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Natural skill at doing something
solution:
The correct answer is: **Knack**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Knack** means the ability or special method for doing something easily and well.

 
 
• Example - *The jazz musician has an incredible **knack **for improvisation.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the** 'Knack'** can be used as a one-word substitute for** 'Natural skill at doing something​'**

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Sense **means the ability to think or act in a reasonable or sensible way; good judgement.
 
• **Awareness **means the state of being conscious of something.
 
• **Passion **means any powerful or compelling emotion or feeling.
